description: Pagefreezer’s website archiving service uses crawling technology, similar to that of Google, to take snapshots of an agency’s website(s). Archiving is an automated and scalable process and requires no software installation. With dynamic monitoring, new webpages and changes to existing pages are always captured, so the website archive is up to date.
